strings: After m_c comes to the medicine den asking for more herbs for their cramps, r_c0 insists on checking up on {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. It appears to be pcos.
m_c has noticed {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} put on a bit of weight, and upon asking r_c0 for advice and being checked out, r_c0 confirms m_c's diagnosis is pcos.
After m_c was stuck in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest with cramps for days, the medicine cat diagnoses {PRONOUN/m_c/object} with pcos.
m_c is shocked to learn that most cat's shark weeks only last a pawful of days rather than what feels like whole moons.
